web-pourie.ref_note: The attached image is the official character sheet. Draw exactly this character: identical proportions, colours, face and outline weight. Do not reproduce the sheet layout; draw only what is described.
web-pourie.template: One single full-body drawing of Pourie, centred, with a generous margin all round and nothing else in the image: {subject}. Transparent background.

web-props.ref_note: The attached image shows the illustration style only: copy its outline weight, flat fills, palette and level of detail. Do not copy its subjects and do not draw any character or face.
web-props.template: One object and nothing else: {subject}. Simple and bold, centred with a generous margin. No face, no character, no text. Transparent background.

web-sheets.ref_note: The attached image is the official character sheet. Draw exactly this character in every frame: identical proportions, colours, face and outline weight. Do not reproduce the sheet layout.
web-sheets.template: An animation sheet: six separate full-body drawings of Pourie arranged in two rows of three on an invisible grid, each drawing the same size, centred in its own cell with clear empty space around it, nothing overlapping and nothing else in the image. The six drawings are consecutive frames of one movement, read left to right along the top row and then the bottom row: {subject}. The character is identical in every frame; only the pose changes. Transparent background.

images.name: web-sheet-cheer
images.subject: frame 1 standing with knees slightly bent and arms low, getting ready to jump; frame 2 pushing off the ground with arms swinging up; frame 3 in the air with both arms straight up and both feet off the ground, eyes closed in joy; frame 4 at the top of the jump with arms up and legs tucked; frame 5 coming down with arms out to the sides; frame 6 landed with knees bent and arms out, big open smile

images.name: web-sheet-sip
images.subject: frame 1 holding a tall glass of water with a striped straw in both hands at waist height, looking at it; frame 2 lifting the glass towards its face; frame 3 the straw at its mouth, eyes open; frame 4 sipping with eyes closed and happy; frame 5 lowering the glass, eyes still closed; frame 6 holding the glass at waist height again with a contented open smile
